description:
## Goal
Give every developer a working local toolchain, git repo, and pnpm/Turbo monorepo so KinVue application code can be added safely.

## Scope
Toolchain install, git init, monorepo scripts, TypeScript/Prettier config, and root folder structure.

## Out of scope
Do not add Docker services, microservice code, or feature APIs in this epic.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-1: Install local toolchain (Node 20, pnpm, Docker, FFmpeg) and verify versions
2. KIN-2: Initialize git repo, add `.gitignore`, commit docs pack
3. KIN-3: Bootstrap pnpm + Turbo monorepo with root scripts (`dev`, `build`, `test`, `lint`, `typecheck`)
4. KIN-4: Add strict root TypeScript + Prettier config
5. KIN-5: Create target folder structure (`apps/`, `packages/`, `infra/`, `tests/`, `scripts/`, `docs/`)

## References
- 28_JIRA_BACKLOG.md

summary: Install local toolchain (Node 20, pnpm, Docker, FFmpeg) and verify versions
description:
## What to do
Install Node.js 20 LTS, pnpm, Docker Desktop, and FFmpeg on your workstation, then confirm each tool runs from the terminal. KinVue cannot be built until this baseline toolchain is in place. No repository code is touched in this task — only your local environment.

## Technical notes
- Run: `node --version`, `pnpm --version`, `docker --version`, `ffmpeg -version`
- Install pnpm globally: `npm install -g pnpm`
- Use Node 20 LTS; Docker Desktop must be running for later infra tasks
- Labels: infra, junior-friendly

## Story points
1

## Depends on
—

## Acceptance criteria
- Node.js 20 LTS installed
- pnpm installed globally
- Docker Desktop installed and running
- FFmpeg available in PATH
- All version commands succeed without errors

- 28_JIRA_BACKLOG.md

## Goal
Provide all local backing services (databases, cache, messaging, search, object storage, observability) via Docker Compose.

## Scope
PostgreSQL ×2, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ, Meilisearch, MinIO + bucket init, Prometheus, Grafana, `.env.example`, health verification.

## Out of scope
Do not implement business logic or HTTP APIs — only infrastructure containers and env documentation.

## Suggested order
1. KIN-11: Create `infra/docker-compose.yml` with Auth PostgreSQL (5433) and Movie PostgreSQL (5434)
2. KIN-12: Add MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ (with management UI), Meilisearch, MinIO to Docker Compose
3. KIN-13: Add MinIO bucket init service for `kinvue-media`
4. KIN-14: Add Prometheus + Grafana to Docker Compose
5. KIN-15: Create `.env.example` with all required env vars and document port map
6. KIN-16: Verify all infra containers healthy (`docker compose ps`, RabbitMQ UI, MinIO console, Meilisearch `/health`)
